items.question: Why has the conference room been reserved all day?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Why has the conference room been reserved all day?”，自然应答是“Do you need a meeting space?”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Do you need a meeting space?）。
